definitions.explanation: The area or people around someone or something.
The distance around the edge of something.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}の{人|ひと}に{迷惑|めいわく}をかけないように。
examples.english: Be careful not to trouble the people around you.

examples.japanese: この{湖|みずうみ}の{周囲|しゅうい}は10キロだ。
examples.english: The circumference of this lake is 10 kilometers.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}の{反対|はんたい}を{押|お}し{切|き}って、{彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}の{夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}いかけることにした。{両親|りょうしん}も{最終的|さいしゅうてき}には{応援|おうえん}してくれた。
examples.english: Overcoming the opposition of those around her, she decided to pursue her dream. Her parents eventually supported her too.

notes:
{周囲|しゅうい} refers to surroundings (people or environment) or physical circumference.

MEANING 1 - SURROUNDINGS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}の{人|ひと} (people around [someone])
- {周囲|しゅうい}の{環境|かんきょう} (surrounding environment)
- {周囲|しゅうい}に{気|き}を{配|くば}る (to be mindful of one's surroundings)
- {周囲|しゅうい}の{目|め} (others' eyes, public scrutiny)

MEANING 2 - CIRCUMFERENCE:
- {周囲|しゅうい}○○メートル (circumference of XX meters)
- {腹|はら}{周|まわ}り / ウエスト{周囲|しゅうい} (waist circumference)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}: surroundings (physical or social)
- {周|まわ}り: around, vicinity (more casual)
- {近所|きんじょ}: neighborhood (residential area)
- {環境|かんきょう}: environment (broader concept)
